Name: Idus SC Deck
Author: Idus
Description: Star Citizen keys for OpenDeck on Linux, grouped as TIME, CZ, STAT, LOG, PLAY and TOOL: server-region clocks and UTC, a one-key Contested Zone hangar timer, STAT views (RSI server status, game version vs newest, funding, VRAM), Game.log views (server/shard, Armistice zone, 30K counter), a launch key and Idus SC Toolbox actions. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games.

Actions.Name: TIME · Server Clock
Actions.Tooltip: Time in a server region (US W, US E, EU, Asia, Australia, your own or any city) or UTC with the date — patches and events are announced in UTC. Amber = local evening, blue = night (by the clock, not live load).

Actions.Name: CZ · Exec Hangar
Actions.Tooltip: Contested Zone executive hangar on one key: open/closed, countdown, the clock time of the next change and the five door lights. Press to re-sync.

Actions.Name: STAT · Status & Stats
Actions.Tooltip: One key, four views: RSI server status (all or one service — press opens the status page), installed game version vs the newest release notes, crowdfunding total, or GPU memory in use.

Actions.Name: LOG · Game.log
Actions.Tooltip: Live from your Game.log, one view per key: server (region + shard + time there), region, shard, Armistice zone, or 30K disconnects this session.

Actions.Name: PLAY · Launch
Actions.Tooltip: Starts Star Citizen (through Idus SC Toolbox if installed, else LUG's sc-launch.sh). Shows RUNNING and the session time.

Actions.Name: TOOL · Toolbox Action
Actions.Tooltip: Runs an Idus SC Toolbox action: kill, restart or patch the launcher, backup, restore, shaders, StarStrings, fix windows. Dangerous ones take three presses (Really? → Sure? → run).
